title: The Brine Chapel
subtitle: Harrow Deep salt workings, chapel level

footer.gm: Referee's map. The example adventure of page-to-poster.
footer.player: Company survey, sixty years out of date

callouts.text: Pivoting slab: the smoke leans toward it
Beam pump: 1 hour halves the pool
Brine, 3 m deep. Odile's offerings lie on the bottom

gm.heading: While they explore: d6 every half hour
lines: 1  A lantern crosses the far end of the passage: Odile, checking her braziers.
2  The brine breathes. Every pool rises a hand's width, sighs, and falls.
3  A smuggler, on the way to the cache (2 in 6: all three).
4  Salt-blind rats, a dozen, drawn to lamp oil.
5  The braziers gutter. Odile comes to relight them within ten minutes.
6  Three slow knocks from below, in the winch shaft.

player.heading: What the shepherd saw
lines: The head-house door stood open. There was fresh candle wax on the stair.
The chapel has been shut for sixty years, since the brine came up.
